title: Emlid GPS NTRIP Protocol
author: Margaret Kalacska
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qs8dwhw

steps.title: Power on MiFi and initialize
steps.instruction: Turn on the MiFi device and wait until it finishes initializing before proceeding.

steps.title: Power on Emlid RS rover
steps.instruction: Turn on the Emlid Reach RS rover and wait for the LEDs to show solid orange, blinking blue, and solid green.

steps.title: Connect mobile device to MiFi Wi‑Fi
steps.instruction: Connect the smartphone or tablet to the Wi‑Fi network broadcast by the MiFi.

steps.title: Verify power, data plan, and NTRIP subscription
steps.instruction: Ensure the internal batteries of the MiFi, the Emlid RS, and the mobile device are fully charged; confirm the MiFi has an active cellular data plan and that you have a valid NTRIP subscription.

steps.title: Access Emlid RS via IP address
steps.instruction: On the mobile device, open a web browser or the Emlid app and enter the rover’s IP address; if the address is unknown, scan the network with the Fing app or select the rover from the app’s device list.

steps.title: Confirm firmware is up‑to‑date
steps.instruction: On the Settings page of the rover interface, verify that the unit’s firmware is the latest version.

steps.title: Configure NTRIP correction input
steps.instruction: Open the Correction Input tab, enter the NTRIP subscription details, set the radio button to **On**, and confirm the bottom of the screen displays “Connected” with the connection information. If using SmartNet, select the appropriate Quebec or Ontario mountpoint.

steps.title: Set GNSS and RTK parameters
steps.instruction: In the RTK tab, select GNSS constellations **GPS, SBAS, GLONASS** (optionally add GALILEO), set the update rate to **1 Hz**, set GPS AR mode to **Fix and Hold**, set GLONASS AR mode to **On**, and ensure elevation > 15° and SNR > 30 dB (values below are not recommended).

steps.title: Disable position output and base mode
steps.instruction: In the Position Output table, set all radio buttons to **Off**; then, in the Base Mode table, set the radio button to **Off**.

steps.title: Enable data logging
steps.instruction: On the Logging tab, turn on the radio buttons for the desired log files.

steps.title: Verify satellite status and bars
steps.instruction: Switch to the Status tab and confirm that both coloured (green/orange) and grey bars are displayed, with at least **5 satellites** showing green bars (these meet the elevation and SNR thresholds).

steps.title: Apply configuration changes
steps.instruction: Click the **Apply** button so that all changes made to the Emlid RS take effect.

steps.title: Troubleshoot Wi‑Fi LED status
steps.instruction: If the rover’s blue LED is solid (instead of slowly flashing), it is broadcasting its own Wi‑Fi network; follow the Emlid quick‑start guide to connect the Reach RS to the MiFi Wi‑Fi network.

steps.title: Collect and export survey points
steps.instruction: Open the Survey tab, set the Antenna Height field to the base height + **65 mm** (e.g., base 1.00 m → antenna height 1.065 m), then collect, save, and export the survey points as described in the Emlid documentation.
